messages:
incident-bot: ⚠️ Paging: Latency SLO breach detected in router region eu-west-2. p95 and p99 for streaming endpoints spiked. Auto-escalation to oncall triggered. thread:5250001234

:siren: sre-oncall: I'm on it. grabbing initial graphs + heatmap. can someone drop the runbook link?

alice: Runbook https://redwood.internal/runbooks/router-latency. quick summary: check routing weight changes, hot-shard telemetry, recent policy rollouts, and regional ejections.

ben: Observed 2x p95 and ~5x p99 on streaming ingest (route:/v1/stream/generate). heatmap shows concentrated tail in shard range 1024-1056 in eu-west-2. looks like hot partitioning + route skew.

carol: Confirming customer impact: CustomerOps: some paying tenants in EU are seeing 10-30s tail stalls on streaming. no total outage but high error/timeouts reported to support.

eng-runtime: Recent router policy rollout completed ~16m ago that changed affinity weights for region fallback (canary to 50%). rolling back would be safe but need approval.

ml-platform: Quick note: model cache hit ratio dropped ~20% in the same region around the same time — might amplify tail when hot partitions form.

sre-oncall: timeline: 16:02 policy rollout, 16:05 p95 rise starts, 16:10 p99 spike. Looks correlated.

alice: Triage steps I'm running now:
1) grab top-k shard tail latencies
2) verify routing table consistency across instances
3) dump connection counts per shard
4) check for recent config seeds

ben: Running quick query on telemetry:```sql
SELECT shard, p99_latency_ms, qps FROM router_metrics
WHERE region='eu-west-2' AND minute >= '2026-03-15T16:00:00Z'
ORDER BY p99_latency_ms DESC LIMIT 20;
```

carol: Results (excerpt):```
shard 1042 p99 41230 ms qps 320
shard 1043 p99 38790 ms qps 290
shard 1044 p99 40210 ms qps 310
shard 1045 p99 39500 ms qps 305
```
these shards are super hot.

eng-runtime: I see the routing table diverged on ~12% of routers — a seed-sync bug in the recent policy rollout. some routers still using old weights which directs extra traffic to the hot shard range.

sre-oncall: OK decision tree:
- immediate mitigation: enable eager fallback to regional spare pool for streaming routes (low friction)
- follow-up: rollback policy rollout seed or force-consistent config push
- long term: fix seed-sync and add canary watch to detect per-shard skew

alice: Executing mitigation: enabling eager fallback for route prefix /v1/stream/* in eu-west-2. Command:```sh
redwoodctl routing set-fallback --region eu-west-2 --route "/v1/stream/*" --policy eager-spare --duration 15m
```

ben: I flipped the fallback at 16:22. monitoring now. anyone watching dashboards?

ml-platform: After the fallback flip: p95 dropped ~30%, p99 down ~45% in 3 minutes. streaming stalls reduced but still elevated on the busiest shards.

customer-ops: Let me know if specific tenants still affected — prepping message templates for status page.

carol: We're still seeing some long tails for a small subset of connections. traces show extra hop/retries where routers reject connection and client retries into same shard range. possibly sticky hashing + partial ejection causing cycling.

eng-runtime: I'm initiating a targeted soft-eviction of the most overloaded endpoints (shards 1042-1045) to redistribute traffic across the pool. Command:```sh
redwoodctl router evict-shard --region eu-west-2 --shard 1042-1045 --mode soft --grace 30s
```

sre-oncall: doing that now (16:28). also scaling dedicated stream workers in eu-west-2 by +20% as additional headroom.

incident-bot: Deployment: scale dstream-eu-west-2 +20% started by sre-oncall at 16:29.

ben: Eviction completed at 16:31. heatmap now more even; p99 looks back to ~1.8-2x baseline instead of 5x. good progress.

alice: We should still rollback the policy rollout that introduced the seed-sync vector. eng-runtime agree?

eng-runtime: Agreed. rolling back seed in a controlled fashion. I'll run a staged config push to avoid oscillation.

ml-platform: Note: we should also rehydrate KV/model cache for streaming workers — some of the rejections were due to cold caches. I'll push a background prefetch job for top tenant prompts.

sre-oncall: rollbacks in progress at 16:40. I'm keeping the eager fallback for another 20 minutes as safety.

customer-ops: Status page draft: "Investigating elevated latency in EU region impacting streaming features for some customers. Mitigations underway; partial recovery observed." I'll publish once we confirm p99 < 2x baseline for 10m.

carol: Post-mitigation checks: run a traffic-split sanity check across routers and verify no single router > 1.5x expected qps. Also collect flamegraphs for slow request traces.

ben: quick sanity output:```json
{"time":"16:35","p95_ms":820,"p99_ms":1950,"note":"reduced from peak"}
```

sre-oncall: Good. Marking incident as live-mitigation resolved at 16:48. follow-ups:
- root cause: policy rollout + seed-sync bug -> routing table drift -> hot partitioning -> cache amplification -> tail spikes
- immediate RCA: rollback policy, enable eager fallback, soft-evict hot shards, scale pool, rehydrate caches
- action items: eng-runtime to fix seed-sync (P0), add canary checks for per-shard skew (P1), ml-platform to add cache prefetch for streaming hot keys (P2), customer-ops to follow up with affected customers (P2).

eng-runtime: I'll open PR with fix and a unit test for seed-sync within the hour.

ml-platform: I'll schedule cache prefetch job and a regression alert for cache-hit drop thresholds.

customer-ops: I'll coordinate targeted customer outreach for tenants who reported timeouts.

alice: Logging final notes: no data loss, no authentication failures, partial customer impact limited to latency/stalls. tagging incident as "routing-tail-eu-west-2-5250001234" for postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident: set status to "mitigated" and created postmortem ticket PM-5250001234.

sre-oncall: Thanks team. I'll follow up with a quick bridge notes summary and hand the oncall to the next shift at 17:00.

carol: thumbs up :thumbsup: will pull flamegraphs and attach to the PM.

ben: closing thread here, keep PM updates in the ticket.

sre-oncall: handing off to next oncall @alex (shadow) at 17:00.

alex: (off-thread) acknowledged, will monitor for 2 hours.
